## Hypothesis

The TV data stale fixer mechanism is designed to monitor and update the TV data feed in real-time, ensuring that the system has access to the most recent and accurate market data. This mechanism will help prevent data staleness and improve the overall performance of the system.

## Mechanism

The TV data stale fixer mechanism will be implemented as a separate thread that runs in the background, continuously monitoring the TV data feed for any updates. If an update is detected, the mechanism will trigger an update to the system's internal data structures, ensuring that the system has access to the latest market data.
